integrity: The all-degree result is based on a complete rational-function reflection proof and an all-degree inductive sharpness construction. The executable exact-rational finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite certificate.
limitations: The threshold is worst-case over all sets of distinct sample sites, not a generic-position threshold.
No noise stability or robust numerical reconstruction is asserted.
The result concerns exact magnitude samples of degree-bounded complex polynomials on a nondegenerate parabola.
Independent external mathematical audit and historical priority verification have not been performed.
title: Sharp universal phaseless polynomial sampling on a parabola
